must: Show one inventory row per registered site
Build multi-report exports entirely inside the browser
Create signed archive links only after confirmation
avoid: Duplicate partition cards on the primary inventory
Create database rows or storage objects during export

decisions.decision: Use a site-first inventory with a three-step archive export wizard.
decisions.reason: Operators need one clear site overview before choosing report coverage and bundle format.

decisions.decision: Package selected archives as a browser-built TAR bundle.
decisions.reason: This supports multiple existing files without adding database or storage quota usage.
